description: You have a text file at /home/ga/Documents/gig_income_notes.txt containing messy income and expense notes from three gig platforms (Uber, DoorDash, Instacart) for Oct-Dec 2024. Create a spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/gig_income_analysis.xlsx that: (1) Aggregates total earnings, hours worked, and gas expenses for each platform, (2) Calculates profit (earnings minus gas) for each platform, (3) Adds a TOTAL row summing all platforms, (4) Calculates estimated self-employment tax owed (15.3% of total profit). Use formulas for calculations and format currency values appropriately. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
